text.description_html:
Brass Accents D05-K250, Rope Trafalgar 2-3/4 x 11 Entrance Set with McKenzie Lever

This custom Single Cylinder Trafalgar Handleset has a 6 Inch center to center and will fit doors with a 2 inch backset. The Trafalgar Entry Set features a detailed rope design along the edge. A long-time classic the Rope Trafalgar 2-3/4 x 11 Entrance Set is both beautiful and well-made. This is a single cylinder handleset, the deadbolt is key operated from the exterior and by a turn knob on interior while a knob or lever operates the latch underneath the deadbolt from the exterior the interior. It comes with the ever popular, with McKenzie Lever.

Single Cylinder: From the exterior, a lever/knob operates the handleset latch and a key operates the deadbolt. From the inside, a thumbturn unlocks the deadbolt and a knob/lever operates the latch.

Features and Specifications of the Single Cylinder Trafalgar Handleset:

  • Material: Solid Cast Brass
  • Trim: McKenzie Lever
  • Interior and Exterior Plate Width: 2-3/4"
  • Interior and Exterior Plate Height: 11"
  • Bore Hole Spacing (distance between deadbolt and trim latch): 6" Center to Center
  • Doors Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/8" or 1-3/4" thick doors
  • Backset: 2"

Sold Individually
